evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), its organization/access (origin), and the separate status fields are all explicitly reported for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement linking an attention condition to the organization/presentation/access of the same identified content.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify content items (color-labeled coordinate sets) and their attributes.

D.rationale: The report separates identified content (coordinate lists) from separate status/organization metadata (origin fields) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The text states how content is presented (layout) and provides explicit origin/access metadata tied to specific content entries.
